item.title: Face-to-face with Hezbollah and under constant rocket fire: IDF troops say the fight has changed
item.description: Golani battalion commander says IDF forces are operating deeper in southern Lebanon than before, using tactics refined in Gaza as they battle Hezbollah terrorists in villages, face close-range ambushes and come under heavy daily rocket fire

item.title: Outrage in Jerusalem over pro-Israel German president who came out against Iran war: 'Ayatollah's dream'
item.description: Frank-Walter Steinmeier is considered one of Israel's greatest friends in Europe, but claims that the attack on the regime in Tehran is illegal; Iranian foreign minister was quick to praise him, the Israeli ambassador in Berlin attacked his words

item.title: IDF Sgt. Aviaad Volansky killed in Hezbollah anti-tank fire in southern Lebanon
item.description: The 21-year-old Jerusalem soldier was killed when Hezbollah fired two anti-tank missiles at his unit; one was intercepted, the other hit a tank, lightly wounding four soldiers, the IDF said

item.title: Why Iran’s missiles keep getting through: the weather factor Israel can’t control
item.description: After eight rounds of sirens from morning into the afternoon, analysts say heavy cloud cover, rain and fog over Iran may be hampering Israeli drone operations and helping Tehran sustain repeated launches toward central Israel

item.title: Katz says Israel killed Iran Revolutionary Guard navy chief amid Hormuz crisis
item.description: 'Important news for our American partners': defense minister says Alireza Tangsiri, blamed for mining operations and disrupting shipping in the strategic waterway, killed in strike as tensions mount over Iran’s threats to close the strait
